name: Kunshan Morning 2021
information: Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, **[Kunshan Morning 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Kunshan-Morning-2021)** and **[Kunshan Afternoon 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Kunshan-Afternoon-2021)**, in two half-days respectively.
